# Introduction

## Calculation Objective (Scope)

*Outline the scope this calculation covers as per the example below.*

This calculation covers the design of the structural steel and foundation for the building.

The structural steel consists of three individual sub-structures isolated to control vibrations. These buildings are all braced framed systems and columns are considered pinned base.

Foundations are either combined or individual spread reinforced concrete footings.

In addition to the main structural framing, this calculation verifies the structural adequacy of:

- Footings including holding down bolts,
- Mechanical frames and equipment plinths,
- Associated chute-work and chute supports.

## Methodology and Structural Load Path

*Outline briefly the structural form being used, a summary of load types, load combinations and what their basis is. Include a brief description of key load paths as per the example below.*

*This section should be no more than half a page.*

The structural system consists of steel braced frames. All floors and columns grids are braced to control vibration.

Structural linear analysis was performed on the structural models in Space Gass to confirm member capacities and connection loads.

Load combinations for both strength and serviceability requirements were based on the worst combinations of dead, live, equipment, wind loads, and earthquake. (As applicable)

The connection checks were completed using Idea Statica.

The dynamic analysis of the secondary screen support under the XRT building and the primary screening building were done using Strand7 program complying with the basis of design.

The main loads this structure carries are as follows:

- Gravity loads from XRT machine and screens,
- Platform live loads,
- Gravity and vibration load from screen feeders and crushers,
- Conveyor loads including belt tensions,
- Horizontal wind loads,
- Earthquake loads.

In terms of horizontal loads, the wind loads control the design of the structure.
